```{r}
clin_dir <- here("data", "clinical_melanoma_rnaseq")
clin_out <- list.files(clin_dir) %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map(~read_tsv(file.path(clin_dir, ..1)))
```

```{r}
clin_metadata <- 
  bind_rows(
    clin_out$clin_metadata_discov.tsv, 
    clin_out$clin_metadata_valid.tsv
  ) 

tpm_df <- 
  bind_rows(
    clin_out$tpm_df_discov.tsv, 
    clin_out$tpm_df_valid.tsv
  )
```
